summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Cresud S.A.C.I.F. y A., a foreign private issuer, announcing the full redemption of its Series XLIX Notes due September 2, 2027. The redemption will occur on September 4, 2026, at 100% of the principal amount plus accrued and unpaid interest, as per the prospectus supplement. This is a routine debt redemption, not a special situation. There is no equity stake, premium, board recommendation, or advisor involved. The key aspect is the issuer exercising its option to redeem notes early, a standard financial event. No risk-arb angle exists; watch for the redemption execution and any impact on the company's capital structure.
